remarks: Private yet moments from town, this exceptional five-bedroom Contemporary Craftsman is a masterclass in workmanship, scale, and thoughtful design. A first-floor primary suite and four additional bedrooms offer flexibility for modern living, while exquisite millwork, refined architectural detail, and open floor plan create spaces equally suited to everyday comfort, working from home, recreation, and entertaining. A gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances and large pantry will please discerning cooks, while a breakfast bar and large dining room allows for easy socializing. A spectacular deck serves as a true extension of the home, complete with an outdoor kitchen, gracious dining and lounge areas, and a charming bridge crossing a peaceful stretch of the Five Mile River, leading to a golf chipping area and small, lovely yard. Additional features include soaring ceilings in the main living area, a two-story foyer, bonus room with deck overlooking the putting green, with bar, wine storage and a half bathroom. The third level offers a private office, a kitchenette, ample storage and fifth bedroom and an en-suite full bath lending the space to flexible use - sunlit gym, guest room, whatever suits. One mile from restaurants, shops and Metro-North, 107 Parade Hill offers the convenience of living close to town and the ease of low-maintenance living.
